title: Milestone 3: Data App
subtitle: Handling data like a Pro.
goal: Build an app that reads and writes files.

blocks.heading: Persistent Data
blocks.html: A To-Do app is useless if it forgets your tasks when it closes. Your next project is a Contact Book that saves data to a file.

blocks.heading: Requirements
blocks.html: Create contacts.py. It should let you Add, View, and Search contacts. But most importantly, it should read from contacts.txt on startup, and save to it when you add someone.

blocks.heading: Share your code
blocks.html: Commit and push to GitHub. You are building a real portfolio now!

blocks.title: Sort the File Writer
blocks.instructions: Drag lines (or use ▲▼) into the correct order to save a contact to a file.

challenge.title: Complete your Contact Book
challenge.instructions: Build the app on your computer and push it to GitHub.
